inventories.name: Google Search
inventories.pricing_source_note: India PPC benchmark plus finance-category economics.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Google may require financial-services verification; keep ad and landing-page disclosures aligned.
inventories.how_to_start: Create a Search campaign in Google Ads; target advisory-intent keywords; add disclosure assets; complete verification if prompted; send traffic to a compliant lead page.

inventories.name: Google Discovery / Demand Gen
inventories.pricing_source_note: Demand Gen inferred from Google visual surfaces and India display/video benchmarks.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Google visual-surface policy review still applies.
inventories.how_to_start: Create a Demand Gen campaign; upload image and short video assets; seed investor lookalikes; exclude rival interests; point traffic to a compliant lead page.

inventories.name: Google Display Network (financial content placements only)
inventories.pricing_source_note: India Google Display and programmatic CPM guidance.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Restrict placements to approved finance/business inventory only.
inventories.how_to_start: Create a Display campaign; use managed placements for finance publishers; exclude low-quality inventory; start with lead-form or landing-page optimization.

inventories.name: YouTube Skippable In-Stream
inventories.pricing_source_note: India YouTube skippable CPV and CPM guidance.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Video disclaimer should remain readable on-screen.
inventories.how_to_start: Build a Video Reach or Demand Gen campaign; upload a 15-30 second explainer; add a compliant CTA; retarget viewers who watched at least 25 percent.

inventories.name: YouTube Non-Skippable (6s Bumper)
inventories.pricing_source_note: India bumper and non-skippable video guidance.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Use a short brand or reminder message only; disclaimer text still needs to be legible.
inventories.how_to_start: Launch a bumper sequence for recall; use a compliance-safe supers template; pair it with Search or Demand Gen retargeting to capture demand.

inventories.name: YouTube Shorts
inventories.pricing_source_note: Shorts benchmark inferred from Demand Gen reach notes and India video CPM ranges.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Use educational hooks, not sensational outcome claims.
inventories.how_to_start: Upload vertical 9:16 assets; keep the first two seconds strong; use lead-focused landing pages or retargeting paths after engagement.

inventories.name: Meta Facebook Feed
inventories.pricing_source_note: Blend of India Meta benchmark guidance and Univest live Facebook Feed CPMs.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Meta may reject exaggerated returns or vague finance claims.
inventories.how_to_start: Open Ads Manager; use Feed-only placement; set a lead objective; upload compliant image or video creative; route to a disclosure-complete landing page or instant form.

inventories.name: Meta Instagram Feed
inventories.pricing_source_note: Blend of India Instagram benchmark guidance and Univest live Instagram Feed CPMs.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Keep the disclaimer visible inside the creative because feed consumption is fast.
inventories.how_to_start: Use Ads Manager with Instagram Feed placement; start with a concise educational creative; connect to a form or landing page that repeats the regulatory disclosure.

inventories.name: Instagram Reels
inventories.pricing_source_note: Blend of India Instagram benchmark guidance and Univest live Reels CPMs.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Use educational hooks and avoid sensational before-versus-after wealth narratives.
inventories.how_to_start: Run vertical 9:16 video through Ads Manager; keep Reels placement only; pair the creative with clear disclosure overlays and a clean lead capture experience.

inventories.name: Meta Audience Network (whitelisted placements only)
inventories.pricing_source_note: Anchored to Univest live Audience Network CPM and CPC data with whitelist-only use.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Use a strict whitelist and exclude low-intent inventory to avoid bad context.
inventories.how_to_start: Activate Audience Network only inside a monitored Meta ad set; use a safe publisher allowlist; shut off placements that generate cheap but low-intent traffic.
inventories.access_notes: Managed inside Meta Ads Manager with whitelist discipline.

inventories.name: LinkedIn Sponsored Content
inventories.pricing_source_note: LinkedIn India rates from Media Ant and professional-targeting benchmarks.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Keep copy factual and targeted to education or consultation, not trading-style urgency.
inventories.how_to_start: Open Campaign Manager; choose Sponsored Content; target finance professionals and high-income business audiences; use a form or landing page with advisory credentials up front.

inventories.name: LinkedIn Message Ads (InMail)
inventories.pricing_source_note: LinkedIn Sponsored InMail benchmark from Media Ant plus India professional lead-gen pricing.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Message copy must stay consultative and avoid personalized return promises.
inventories.how_to_start: Use Message Ads or Conversation Ads in Campaign Manager; target a narrow professional segment; send a compliance-safe consultation offer with explicit firm credentials.

inventories.name: Moneycontrol Display & Native
inventories.pricing_source_note: Moneycontrol banner, video, roadblock, and article rates from Media Ant.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Native content must be clearly labeled sponsored and should not read like unverified stock advice.
inventories.how_to_start: Request the Moneycontrol media kit; choose banner or sponsored-content inventory; submit compliance-cleared creative; confirm business-news adjacency before launch.
inventories.access_notes: Direct buy or managed marketplace booking.

inventories.name: Economic Times (ET) Display & Sponsored Content
inventories.pricing_source_note: ET banner, article, listicle, and roadblock rates from Media Ant.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Sponsored content should stay educational and prominently labeled.
inventories.how_to_start: Request ET digital inventory; pick banner or sponsored article units; share approved claims and disclaimers; ask for business or markets adjacency.

inventories.name: Mint (HT Media) Display
inventories.pricing_source_note: Livemint marketplace rates used as the HT Media digital benchmark for Mint display.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Keep premium-publisher creatives conservative and evidence-based.
inventories.how_to_start: Request HT Media digital placements for Mint; choose banner inventory; provide approved creative and disclaimer copy; ask for business-news section priority.
inventories.access_notes: Direct HT Media buy or managed marketplace booking.

inventories.name: Business Standard Digital
inventories.pricing_source_note: Business Standard digital banner, article, and roadblock rates from Media Ant.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Sponsored content should be plainly marked and fact-based.
inventories.how_to_start: Request Business Standard digital inventory; select banner or article inventory; send approved creative and landing page; confirm finance-news adjacency.

inventories.name: NDTV Profit Display
inventories.pricing_source_note: NDTV digital benchmark used as the NDTV Profit proxy due shared premium news inventory.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Use business-news-safe messaging and no speculative trading claims.
inventories.how_to_start: Request NDTV Profit or NDTV business inventory; lock banner or video inventory; submit approved creative; confirm finance or markets adjacency.
inventories.access_notes: Direct buy with publisher or managed marketplace.

inventories.name: Value Research Online (direct buy)
inventories.pricing_source_note: No public Value Research rate card surfaced; pricing inferred from premium finance-publisher display bands.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Keep copy educational and avoid stock-tip framing on a research-led audience environment.
inventories.how_to_start: Reach out through Value Research commercial or editorial contacts for sponsorship availability; request desktop and newsletter options; confirm legal review before launch.

inventories.name: Livemint Newsletter Sponsorship
inventories.pricing_source_note: Newsletter sponsorship benchmark inferred from Livemint premium rates plus India email/newsletter entry pricing.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Newsletter copy must disclose the advisory identity immediately.
inventories.how_to_start: Request the Livemint newsletter sponsorship menu; choose a markets or business slot; supply a disclaimer-safe sponsor block; link to a compliant lead page.
inventories.access_notes: Direct publisher or managed marketplace booking.

inventories.name: JioCinema Pre-Roll
inventories.pricing_source_note: JioCinema video benchmark from JioHotstar/JioCinema planning pages and IPL inventory guidance.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Keep messaging educational and avoid live-trading style claims.
inventories.how_to_start: Request pre-roll inventory on relevant finance, business, or premium-content clusters; submit a six to fifteen second compliance-safe video; confirm contextual adjacency.

inventories.name: Hotstar / Disney+ Hotstar Pre-Roll
inventories.pricing_source_note: JioHotstar video rates from official Jiostar terms/contact path and Media Ant rate cards.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Use awareness or education creative, not speculative trading language.
inventories.how_to_start: Contact Jiostar ad sales; reserve pre-roll inventory; align the video cut to the selected content cluster; clear the disclaimer treatment before launch.

inventories.name: Spotify Audio Ads (India)
inventories.pricing_source_note: Spotify India audio and video CPM ranges from Media Ant marketplace listing.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Audio scripts must avoid exaggerated income claims and clearly name the advisory brand.
inventories.how_to_start: Book Spotify audio inventory; upload a 30-second compliance-safe script; pair the audio slot with a clickable banner or landing page for response.
inventories.access_notes: Spotify Ads Studio or managed marketplace booking.

inventories.name: Times of India Digital Display
inventories.pricing_source_note: Times of India digital banner, article, and roadblock rates from Media Ant.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Use TOI as top-funnel reach or broad credibility inventory, not aggressive response copy.
inventories.how_to_start: Request TOI digital placements; select high-visibility display inventory; confirm premium-news or business adjacency if available; send approved creative assets.
inventories.access_notes: Managed marketplace or direct publisher buy.

inventories.name: BSE/NSE Investor Portal (if available for direct buy)
inventories.pricing_source_note: No public exchange website rate card was confirmed; pricing inferred from premium investor-publisher display bands.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Exchange-facing creative may require exchange-specific advertisement approval or legal review before publication.
inventories.how_to_start: Confirm whether the exchange or portal accepts sponsorship; route the creative through compliance review; obtain any required exchange approval before booking.
inventories.access_notes: Availability must be confirmed directly with the exchange or portal partner.

inventories.name: Google Performance Max
inventories.pricing_source_note: Performance Max inferred from blended Search, Display, and Demand Gen market ranges.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Keep asset groups tightly controlled and review spillover frequently.
inventories.how_to_start: Create a Performance Max campaign with strict asset groups, finance-safe audience signals, compliant creative assets, and a qualified lead conversion goal.

inventories.name: Meta Advantage+ Shopping (configured for lead gen)
inventories.pricing_source_note: Advantage+ lead benchmark inferred from Meta feed/reels auction ranges and India Meta guidance.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Advantage+ can expand quickly, so claims should stay conservative and pre-approved.
inventories.how_to_start: Create an Advantage+ campaign using compliant product-style creative, a lead objective or form integration, and exclusions for weak placements or audiences.

inventories.name: Taboola (financial content sites whitelist)
inventories.pricing_source_note: Taboola uses CPC or CPM pricing; India benchmark inferred from native/programmatic marketplace ranges with finance whitelisting.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Run only on an approved finance and business publisher whitelist.
inventories.how_to_start: Create a Taboola campaign; upload native creative; whitelist finance publishers only; add compliance-safe headlines; optimize on qualified leads rather than cheap clicks.
inventories.access_notes: Programmatic self-serve with strict whitelist controls.

inventories.name: OutBrain (financial content sites whitelist)
inventories.pricing_source_note: Outbrain CPC benchmark inferred from native/programmatic marketplace ranges; official help confirms CPC add-on pricing.
inventories.sebi_compliance_note: Show SEBI registration details, fair-risk language, and no assured-return claims. Use a finance-safe publisher whitelist and plain-language native headlines only.
inventories.how_to_start: Launch through Outbrain; whitelist premium finance and business publishers; connect only compliant editorial-style creatives; optimize to qualified lead events.
